name: Mindful Thought Observation
equipment: A quiet space and a comfortable seat
instructions: Sit comfortably with your eyes closed or gaze softened, and take a few settling breaths.
Imagine your thoughts as clouds passing across the sky of your mind.
As each thought arises, simply notice it without following it, and let it drift by.
If you get caught up in a thought, gently note "thinking" and return to watching.
After 5 minutes, take a deep breath and open your eyes.
